subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this provider-backed WeChat hot-reload change show a redacted live account-A/account-B QR-login result before merge, or may maintainers accept the focused gateway lifecycle regressions as sufficient?
rationale: The contributor has been explicit that the available evidence is source-level and test-level only, while repository policy requires live verification for feasible external API work; this is a proof threshold that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with an approved WeChat setup attaches redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording showing account A remains online after account B logs in.

options.title: Accept gateway-level proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider proof and accept the current focused lifecycle regressions, type checking, linting, build, and required exact-head checks as the merge evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with an approved WeChat setup attaches redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording showing account A remains online after account B logs in.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline routes gateway review to this person; confidence is limited because supplied material does not establish current file ownership.
